name: SHINJUKU SOUMEI
source:
In Shinjuku Soumei, the protagonist is an undertaker who uses his powers of “immortality” and “hearing the voices of the dead” to perform dangerous funerals in the city of Shinjuku. Beside him is an astral girl he met in Shinjuku, who lends him her support.

[From [url=https://www.gematsu.com/2023/08/g-mode-and-plus81-announce-visual-novel-shinjuku-soumei]Gematsu[/url]]
translation:
在《新宿苍明》中，主人公是一名殡葬承办人，他利用自己的“永生”和“听到死者的声音”的力量，在新宿市举办危险的葬礼。在他身边的是他在新宿遇到的一位星界女孩，她为他提供了支持。

[来自[url=https://www.gematsu.com/2023/08/g-mode-and-plus81-announce-visual-novel-shinjuku-soumei]Gematsu[/url]]
